Name: TB Screening Not Done
Criteria: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p JOIN visit v ON v.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.voided = 0 AND v.voided = 0 AND v.date_stopped IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter e JOIN encounter_type et ON e.encounter_type = et.encounter_type_id WHERE e.visit_id = v.visit_id AND e.voided = 0 AND et.uuid = '${var.encountertype.tb-screening.uuid}')
Message: TB screening not done: complete the TB Screening form for this visit
